capture_admission_precision.denominator: all actually saved candidates including wrong/negative-case/earlier-turn saves
capture_admission_precision.requires: native operation + independent readback; per semantic origin; CLI seeds excluded

capture_opportunity_coverage.numerator: original gold-save cases with every required reusable claim correctly saved
capture_opportunity_coverage.identity: both original claims in one opportunity; no negative case creates an opportunity

atomic_claim_coverage.numerator: correctly saved original positive gold claims
atomic_claim_coverage.identity: two claims; no double count across earlier/repeated saves

incorrect_support.numerator: saved unsupported or unknown atomic claims
incorrect_support.denominator: all actually saved atomic claims, including extra claims; independently segment every saved candidate

condition_retention.denominator: applicable gold conditions in actually saved gold-positive cases
condition_retention.notes: Do not remove lost conditions from denominator; omissions/no saves reported via fixed coverage. Gold claim text also carries conditions even if no conditions array exists (identity gamma observation-only).

false_continuity.numerator: different/unknown cases incorrectly carrying prior evidence into the current task
false_continuity.notes: Current review binding required; earlier correctly scoped alpha save is not a false beta/unknown continuation.

false_split.numerator: same-task cases incorrectly losing needed prior evidence

unknown.denominator: all actually reviewed cases per capture/maintenance and stratum
unknown.notes: Case contributes at most once per family/stratum; retain per-review counts separately. Pre-model no dispatch/screening is not a model semantic review. Unavailable-source deterministic unknown is recorded separately, not invented semantic review.

exact_duplicate_error.numerator: incorrect distinct/duplicate or missed exact duplicate decisions
exact_duplicate_error.notes: Report distinct-key and identical-replay components with separate exercise status; replay remains blocked. No semantic dedup inference.

maintenance_false_revision.notes: Include denied decisions; independent adjudication required for every row. A row with unknown correctness blocks the numerator/rate, not an exclusion.

maintenance_false_delete.notes: Same issuance trace; denied wrong delete is still wrong. Enumerate pre-issuance wrong deletes separately too.

missed_maintenance.numerator: original authorized update/delete cases lacking a correct verified native outcome
missed_maintenance.notes: verified-condition-update and verified-retirement only; unrun cases are pending, never measured failures/zero errors or N/A.

maintenance_condition_loss.denominator: all still-valid unique facts/conditions in actually revised participating records
maintenance_condition_loss.notes: Include erroneous revisions; list pre/post fact inventory per participant. Recovery-only expected_body never supplies a semantic fact inventory.

latency_cost.definition: p50/p95 per completed review; review count, real dispatch count, input/output tokens and total cost; unknown values null
latency_cost.notes: Controlled I1/I2 and all earlier turns charged separately. Never infer free usage from missing prices.

missingness: not_run when no run; blocked when required trace, source, adjudication or authorized execution absent. N/A only after completed eligible population is observed empty, with evidence of complete enumeration. Unrun is never N/A; partial runs do not shrink frozen case denominators. Any unexpected actually saved record remains in saved denominators even when its gold case is skip. Natural corrected output of a negative supplied-challenge case is judged independently, not automatically wrong and not new coverage.
